messages:
Elaine: Quick heads-up — we're previewing audit event schema 2.3 in staging tomorrow. This changes the event.detail fields for KMS key usage and adds an rbac.action field. Need two things: (1) quick QA from folks who own customer-facing docs/examples, (2) feedback on sample payloads for customer validation.
Marco: Can you paste the sample payloads here? want to check rbac shape.
Elaine: sure, attaching minimal sample:
```json
{
  "event_type": "key_access",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-20T15:02:00Z",
  "principal": {
    "id": "svc-user-123",
    "type": "service_account"
  },
  "rbac": {
    "action": "decrypt",
    "resource": "projects/prod1/keys/ingest-key",
    "policy_version": "v1"
  },
  "kms": {
    "key_id": "kms-az-01",
    "operation_id": "op-9f8d",
    "wrapped_key": false
  }
}
```
Priya: Looks fine. For KMS we should include correlation_id and a customer_visible boolean so customers can filter internal vs customer ops.
Elaine: Good call. I'll add correlation_id and customer_visible to kms.
Kyle: For docs: we should add a migration guide that maps v2.2 -> v2.3 fields and a sample validator script (small Python snippet) so customers can run against their logs.
Elaine: I'll draft the docs PR today and post the link. Expect a staging deploy around 10:30 PT. sec-bot will post deploy status.
sec-bot: docs-site deploy started (build #4821) :building:
Marco: :eyes: I'll review the sample payloads + validator tomorrow morning.
Priya: also let's call out which audit events are considered PII by default — security/privacy team needs signoff before we publish customer-facing samples.
Elaine: noted. adding a privacy checklist item. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
sec-bot: docs-site deploy completed (build #4821) :white_check_mark:
Kyle: When you open the PR, mention downstream customers in the release notes and include a migration example for Splunk/ELK ingestion.
Elaine: Will do. PR ETA 2pm PT.
